Milestone reached Sunday, after Democrat Chuck Hubbard defeated Republican Virginia Foxx in North Carolina
House Democrats have secured their best general election result in decades, winning at least 258 seats in a midterm election sweep unseen since 1992 that creates not only vast opportunities to govern but also intense pressure to deliver on campaign promises and priorities.
Democrats have gained 44 House seats so far, four more than the 40 they picked up in Donald Trump’s first midterm in 2018.
The 258-seat tally was reached on Sunday, after Democrat Chuck Hubbard defeated Republican representative Virginia Foxx in North Carolina. Four other House races remain outstanding: one each in Minnesota and Tennessee, and two in Louisiana that are heading to a December runoff.
The milestone in the 435-member House sets up a divided government, with the Senate also in Democratic hands and with a Republican president in the White House. Emboldened Democrats are preparing a 100-day agenda to address high costs of living while also confronting Trump with a vast oversight agenda for the remainder of his second term in office.
The Democrats’ majority will be bigger than any the party has seen in elections since Bill Clinton was first elected president in 1992 (258) or the election of Barack Obama in 2008 (257), yet not quite the high-water mark of the Franklin D Roosevelt-era, which saw House Democratic majorities swell past 300.
“Like, hell yeah, we should feel pressure,” said Democratic representative Jason Crow of Colorado, a former army ranger.
“There are people dying in this country and people losing their healthcare, losing their livelihoods, losing their farms, being terrorized from ICE,” he said at the Capitol, referring to US Immigration and Customs Enforcement. “If you don’t feel a sense of urgency and pressure in this job, and a desperation to deliver for folks, then you don’t belong under this Capitol dome.”
The numbers underscore the extraordinary scale of Democratic wins, which spanned from the strongest Republican states to the midwest and east coast as voters, angry over high prices and the Iran war and concerned over corruption, made clear their discontent with Trump.
Taking control of both the House and the Senate come January, the Democrats will carry with them the backing of voters and the expectations to deliver. The Senate Democrats won a 56-seat majority in the 100-member chamber, their biggest advantage in over a decade.
The Democrats, as part of their 100-day agenda, are planning swift votes to reverse the Republicans’ Medicaid cuts and restore the Affordable Care Act tax credits the Republicans allowed to expire.
Democrats have vowed to marshal their subpoena powers and launch a flurry of investigations to exert the role of Congress as a check on presidential power. That includes plans to probe how Trump and his family have become wealthier since he returned to office. Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries of New York, who is in line to become House speaker, has not ruled out trying to impeach Trump for a third time.
“This is a historic moment for our country. This is one of the largest classes we have seen,” said Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, the progressive New York congresswoman, at the Capitol.
Representative Tom Suozzi, a centrist Democrat from New York and an accountant by profession, said the House Democrats should focus 75% of their time on affordability issues and 25% on accountability.
“Everything should be tied back to the people – and how it’s affecting the people,” he said.
For example, he said, as the Democrats launch investigations into Trump’s financial dealings, they should be connecting the dots: “How does that affect people’s pocketbooks?”
After the Republican House speaker Mike Johnson struggled to keep the House functioning for the past two years with a narrow 218-214 Republican majority – meaning any few GOP lawmakers could derail the agenda – the Democrats wide margin provides the new leadership much more room to maneuver.
Jeffries, who is poised to make history as the first Black speaker of the House if his colleagues elect him to the job on 3 January 2027, will be able to lose dozens of Democrats on any given vote and still have the 218 needed for passage.
Republicans saw their number of House seats fall to one of the lowest tallies in decades. Representative Jim Jordan of Ohio, who was elected by his colleagues to be the Republican leader in the minority, vowed to fight their way back to power.
“Over the next two years, House Republicans will fight for American families,” Jordan said.

Chuck Hubbard is a former journalist whose first political campaign was in 2022
The Democratic Party has won the largest majority in the US House of Representatives since 1992, after Democrat Chuck Hubbard unseated Republican Representative Virginia Foxx in North Carolina.
The race was called on Sunday, with Hubbard beating Foxx by 330 votes with 99% counted. It was one of the closest contests of the recent midterm elections, in which Democrats also secured the Senate.
The party has now won at least 258 House seats in the midterms compared to Republicans, who hold at least 173 seats, with four races still yet to be called.
Neither party had won as many House races since 1992, when Bill Clinton won the presidency and Democrats won a total of 258 seats.
Sunday's result came after Foxx, who has represented North Carolina's 5th Congressional District since 2005, requested a recount. This is allowed under state law when the margin of victory is under 1%.
She conceded on Sunday, saying in a statement: "After running a campaign focused on my track record of commonsense solutions and conservative values, I'm humbled and grateful that so many North Carolina voters responded by supporting my candidacy, even if we came up just a few votes short."
Virginia Foxx spent a decade in the North Carolina Senate before representing the state in the House of Representatives
Hubbard, meanwhile, wrote on X that he had spoken to Foxx, "who graciously conceded following the results of the recount process".
He added: "I deeply appreciate her commitment to a smooth transition of the office and constituent casework. We may not always agree, but we both love North Carolina and the people of the Fifth District."
Hubbard's win, which comes after he lost to Foxx in the 2024 midterms by nine percentage points, followed a number of Democratic victories in deeply Republican districts including South Carolina, Texas, Alaska and Iowa.
Hubbard, like many Democrats running in the midterms, focused on the rising cost of living in the US during the war with Iran - a top issue for voters.
President Donald Trump himself has suggested inflation caused by the war in Iran was probably to blame for the Republican losses, as well as Vice President JD Vance.
Hubbard has also said he will also prioritise working families and small businesses, supporting public education and expanding access to affordable healthcare, according to his website.
The remaining House races yet to be called are in Tennessee and Minnesota, while two elections in Louisiana will go to a runoff in December. In Tennessee's fourth district, Democrat Victoria Broderick leads by fewer than 300 votes, and in Minnesota's first district, Democrat Jake Johnson is winning by fewer than 500 votes.
Democrats may use their upcoming majority in the House and control of the Senate to investigate conflicts of interest and other actions by the president and those close to him, while the Senate also has the power to confirm or block the president's cabinet and judicial nominations. They will also be able to pass legislation through Congress easily, though Trump still has to give final sign off for it to become law.
However, even with control of both chambers of Congress, they will still have limits on their power as Trump can veto legislation.

No one has claimed responsibility for the strike on the vessel, which had docked on its way back to Russia
A suspected Ukrainian drone attack caused an explosion on a Russian warship docked at the naval base in the Libyan port city of Benghazi, Libyan officials have said.
The strike severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy warship, and ignited a fire at the naval base, they said. Several Ukrainian sea drones were launched at the ship from a base run by Ukrainian forces in western Libya , according to an initial investigation into the attack. At least four drones were intercepted and destroyed, while two hit the warship, the officials told the Associated Press.
The officials were affiliated with the self-styled Libyan National Army, which controls eastern and southern Libya.
There was no immediate reaction from Russian authorities, and no immediate claim of responsibility for the strike, but it comes as Ukrainian forces have stepped up their long-range barrages against Russia far beyond the frontlines.
Authorities in divided Libya’s east said in a statement that the vessel had stopped at Benghazi port to refuel and ⁠resupply on its way back to Russia, ​under maritime cooperation agreements between ‌the two ‌countries.
In a separate attack, another sea drone hit a commercial vessel off the port of Benghazi on Sunday evening, Libyan military sources told Reuters. Libyan naval forces ‌rescued the vessel’s crew, the ‌sources added. The health ministry said some crew members were in stable condition with minor injuries. The number of injured and their nationalities are not known.
The ‌eastern-based Libyan authority said port and naval base facilities, including warehouses, were safe and that ​normal operations would resume once the fire was brought under control and the site secured.
It condemned the suspected attack as a violation of Libya’s sovereignty and ⁠a threat to maritime safety, saying it would take ​legal and ​diplomatic measures against ​anyone found responsible. “The Libyan government will not ​allow Libyan ‌ports, territory or territorial ​waters ​to be turned into an arena for settling scores or exporting international conflicts,” it said.
The specialist website Naval News also identified the ship attacked as the Merkury, a Russian corvette – the smallest class of warship, smaller than a frigate – and said it was almost certainly destroyed.
HI Sutton, a naval analyst, said the attack was probably conducted by sea drones, after a photograph of one emerged apparently taken off the Libyan coast. The drone, he said, “is also likely the type used in the subsequent attack”.
If it is confirmed that Ukraine has been able to blow up or seriously damage a Russian warship in Benghazi, it would represent one of its most successful naval strikes during the almost five-year war.
But it also represents a risky extension of the fighting far beyond eastern Europe, in an incident that could affect civilians in another continent and the working of the port.
A small unit of Ukrainian special forces operatives has been based at Misrata, western Libya, and is believed to have coordinated drone attacks on Russian tankers and transport ships in the past year.
Initial reports and footage suggest the Merkury was struck from above, potentially by a drone, launched no more than a few kilometres away from the target in port.
Russia is close to the Benghazi authorities that control eastern Libya. It uses the port, which has a growing importance since it lost bases in Syria, to supply Russian mercenary forces in Africa and as a base in the Mediterranean.
Separately, a fire onboard a Russian cargo ship that was ⁠struck by drones in the ⁠Baltic Sea continued to smoulder ​on Sunday, Finland’s border guard said, with emergency services from Finland, Russia and Estonia working together to put out the blaze.
The Finnish military said the strike on the Sparta II ⁠on Saturday was probably carried out by Ukraine and that the vessel later drifted into Finnish waters, where it remained at anchor. The 16 crew members were evacuated on to a nearby Russian ship. One crew member was slightly ⁠injured.
On Sunday, visible flames had been put out, with operations focusing on cooling down the containers and stabilising the vessel, Finnish authorities said.
The ship, bound for the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad, had been damaged in international waters west of Russia’s Gogland Island, Finland’s defence forces said, corroborating an account by Russian officials.
Kyiv has sent waves of military drones towards the Leningrad region on Russia’s north-west coast this year, including some that strayed into the airspace of nearby Baltic countries, leading to fears that the war was spilling on to Nato territory.
The risk of ⁠further attacks in the Gulf of Finland, a narrow arm of the Baltic Sea, could not be ruled ​out, Ivo Värk, the Estonian navy commander, told the public ​broadcaster ERR on Sunday.
Finland’s military said last ​week it had detected a strike on a Russian warship in the same area during Ukrainian drone attacks.

Dozens of militant Israeli settlers raided communities on Saturday night, setting fire to vehicles and several homes
Arson attacks by militant Israeli settlers on Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank have caused a political row in Israel, drawing condemnation from Gadi Eisenkot, the opposition leader, who described them as “Jewish terrorism”.
Dozens of settlers raided Palestinian communities overnight on Saturday, setting fire to about a dozen vehicles and several homes and scrawling racist graffiti. At least four communities were attacked. Israeli police said they had launched an investigation with forensic teams.
Photographs from Kafr Malik , near Ramallah, showed one slogan written in Hebrew that read: “This is the first revenge.” Several vehicles and homes had been set alight in the village.
Images from nearby Deir al-Sudan showed vehicles on fire. Palestinian reports said an agricultural building had been set ablaze in Deir Ballut and cars torched in Deir Abu Mashal.
An ⁠inconclusive election last month stripped Benjamin Netanyahu, the prime minister, of his majority. Eisenkot has been asked to form a government, though his prospects seem little better.
“Last night’s arson attacks in Judea and Samaria were acts of Jewish terrorism, in every sense of the term,” Eisenkot said, using the biblical name for the West Bank. “Extremist groups that set fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional stability, putting lives at risk and doing grave damage to Israel’s national security and foreign relations.”
Referring to the far-right ministers Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich, he added: “The actions led by Ben-Gvir and Smotrich in the West Bank have brought the area to the brink of unchecked anarchy.”
Eisenkot, who has been given 28 days to form a government by the president, Isaac Herzog, with a possible 14-day extension, urged the government and security establishment to “use every tool at their disposal – including administrative detention and targeted operations by the Shin Bet – to stop the rioters and impose harsh sanctions on them”.
In an unprecedented rebuke on Sunday, several other members of the Israeli parliament criticised Netanyahu over escalating violence by militant settlers against Palestinians.
Yair Lapid, the leader of Yesh Atid, held Netanyahu’s government responsible for encouraging the attacks. “Jewish terrorism is the product of criminal negligence by the Israeli government,” he said on X, adding that ministers were deliberately encouraging the militant settlers’ violence “through their silence”.
Yair Golan, the leader of the Democrats party, warned of the possibility of a third intifada and described the West Bank as “on the brink of an explosion”.
“Anyone who wants to prevent a third intifada must replace the current government, which provides cover and support for Jewish terrorism and abandons security,” Golan said on X. “Jewish terrorism harms innocent Palestinians and Israeli army soldiers, and pushes Israel toward unprecedented international isolation.”
Noam Tibon, a retired army major general and Knesset member, gave a similar warning. “If Israel does not eliminate Jewish terrorism in the West Bank, it will destroy Israel,” he wrote.
Australia announced sanctions on Wednesday against three people and four Israeli entities, including a construction company, over their role in the expansion of illegal settlements and human rights abuses against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank.
A day earlier the UK imposed sanctions on eight Israeli construction companies involved in building illegal settlements in the West Bank, which the UN regards as Palestinian territory under Israeli occupation since 1967.
Since the 7 October 2023 Hamas-led attacks on Israel, there has been a surge of Israeli settlement expansion and violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank. More than 1,100 Palestinians have been killed there by Israeli forces or settlers.
On Tuesday, a 72-year-old Palestinian woman was shot dead in an overnight attack by Israeli militant settlers in a village near Jericho, where the group has recently moved in after taking over several Palestinian homes.

Green shoots of recovery have lasted longer in a blast furnace than in the Mauricio Pochettino era at ­Manchester United. On another abysmal Anfield day for the fallen giants of Manchester, Pochettino endured a baptism of fire from the eighth minute onwards when Leny Yoro was sent off for ­denying Alexander Isak a clear goalscoring opportunity. Liverpool would not be denied anything else while tormenting their old rivals yet again.
Andoni Iraola indulged in his first fist-pumps towards the Kop after an utterly dominant, comfortable win illuminated by Rio Ngumoha and Florian Wirtz brilliance plus goals from Dominik Szoboszlai and Víctor Muñoz. Liver­pool’s two creative forces were also on the scoresheet as Ngumoha became the youngster scorer in the fixture’s history.
“Poch is at the wheel” was the mocking, merciless soundtrack that accompanied the end of the former Tottenham, Chelsea and USA coach’s first traumatic game in the job. There may well be more. On this evidence, 19th in the Premier League is not a misleading reflection of United’s position.
The latest calamity in United’s worst start to a season for 40 years cannot be pinned on a head coach who met his new charges only on Wednesday. There can be no genuine takes on Pochettino’s vision for United either, given how quickly he was forced to turn his first game into a damage-limitation exercise. But there was one firm conclusion to be drawn. His first big call in the job proved a serious mistake with destructive repercussions for United’s entire evening.
• Accounting for 3pts/win all-time, Manchester United’s eight points this season are their fewest after 11 games of a league campaign since 1972-73 (7). That is also the previous season in which the Red Devils managed only one win through their first 11 league matches.
• Mauricio Pochettino (pictured) suffered the joint-heaviest defeat by a Manchester United manager in his first game (0-4), along with a defeat by the same scoreline for Lal Hilditch in October 1926 (0-4 v Bolton Wanderers in the top flight).
• Manchester United end the day in 19th position in the Premier League, with this the first time since November 1986 that they have been within the bottom two places of the league table having played at least 10 matches (21st in that case).
• Mauricio Pochettino was the first manager in Premier League history to see his team concede twice and receive a red card in the first half of his first match in charge of a club. Opta
That ill-fated decision was to hand Matthijs de Ligt a first Premier League start in 12 months at the expense of Harry Maguire. Maguire may be a symbol of United’s inertia, but his replacement at centre-back was heavily responsible for the chaos that quickly unfolded. The Netherlands international was at fault for three goals. Liverpool , under instruction from Iraola to start strong and “make them feel pressure from the beginning”, could hardly believe their luck at the first mishap in the visitors’ central defence.
De Ligt lost the flight of the ball and his man, Isak, when Ronald Araújo pinged a routine pass down Liverpool’s right-hand channel. Isak was suddenly away, De Ligt all at sea, and to compound matters Yoro was slow to react to the danger. By the time United’s covering defender was across to challenge Isak it was too late. Yoro clattered into the back of the Sweden international just outside the area and was shown a straight red card by the referee, Sam Barrott. Isak’s heavy first touch could not save Yoro. The free-kick could not save United from double jeopardy. Szoboszlai swept a powerful set piece into Senne Lammens’ bottom right-hand corner from 19 yards.
Pochettino claimed the dismissal was wrong and United should have had a penalty moments earlier for a Jérémy Jacquet challenge on Bryan Mbeumo. It was a desperate take. A simple detail showed the extent of the job United’s latest head coach has on his hands: the wall that lined up to face Szoboszlai’s free-kick. Just getting that right was beyond this group of players. White shirts lined up to protect the left side of Lammens’ goal but, with the isolated exception of Bruno Fernandes, no one covered the spot where the ball was ultimately placed.
Liverpool devoured the gifts. When the hosts doubled their lead three minutes later thoughts of another 7-0 humiliation for United did not seem unreasonable. Ngumoha tormented Diogo Dalot from the first whistle, as everyone inside the ground expected he would. Having been found by Isak’s cross-field pass the teenager breezed past Dalot to the byline and lifted a cross slightly behind Wirtz. The German playmaker, left in space by De Ligt, improvised brilliantly to hook a volley into the roof of the net while floating in mid-air. United were sinking into the abyss.
The first chants of “sacked in the morning” flowed from the Kop towards a disbelieving United head coach. There were 14 minutes on the clock. It was, of course, a ludicrous chant. It might be months before United’s hapless owners are seeking another scapegoat.
Pochettino responded in the only way he could to the onslaught and introduced Maguire into a rejigged five-man defence. Whether in the knowledge that United possessed neither the ability nor the inclination to hurt them, Liverpool eased off for the remainder of the first half although Isak and Alexis Mac Allister could have extended the lead.
Liverpool did not let their rivals off so lightly after the restart. ­Bradley Barcola could and should have provided Wirtz with a hat-trick of assists but squandered three beautiful touches from the £116m recruit. ­Virgil van Dijk put a free header wide from another fine delivery by Wirtz. ­Barcola turned provider in ­devastating style, however, to ­create the goal that Ngumoha’s display richly deserved. The France winger burst away from Lisandro Martínez and Fernandes with one flick of the ball before delivering an assist on a plate for the teenager to convert.
Iraola’s thoughts started to drift towards the midweek Champions League trip to Club Brugge and he started resting players from the 72nd minute onwards. But Liverpool were not done. Another mistake by De Ligt, this time a sloppy pass infield, was pounced on by Wirtz who released Muñoz inside the box. The Liverpool substitute stroked an emphatic finish past Lammens. All Sir Alex Ferguson could do up in the directors’ box in the closing stages was laugh with his friend, the actor James Nesbit. The alternative is too bleak for a proud United man to contemplate.
• Since the start of the 2021-22 season, Liverpool's four wins by 4+ goals against Manchester United are the most any Premier League team has achieved against another across all competitions.
• Andoni Iraola is unbeaten in his seven Premier League matches against Manchester United (W3 D4). The only manager to record a longer unbeaten run against the Red Devils in the competition is Jürgen Klopp (8 between 2018 and 2022).
• This was the quickest Liverpool had gone 2-0 up in a Premier League match against Manchester United, going two ahead after just 12 minutes and 40 seconds.
• Rio Ngumoha (18y 85d) became the youngest player to score and assist in a Premier League game for Liverpool since Michael Owen on Boxing Day 1997 (18y 12d v Leeds United).
• Dominik Szoboszlai (pictured) scored his fifth direct free kick for Liverpool in the Premier League; only Jamie Redknapp (8), Steven Gerrard (7) and Trent Alexander-Arnold (6) have netted more for the club in the competition.
• Florian Wirtz created 10 chances in open play for Liverpool, the most by a player in a Premier League match since Manchester City’s David Silva against West Brom in March 2015 (11). Opta

Democrat Chuck Hubbard was elected to the US House of Representatives from North Carolina on Sunday after defeating veteran Republican Virginia Foxx, who chairs the powerful House Rules Committee. His victory gave Democrats their best general election result in decades, winning at least 258 seats in the 2026 US midterms.
House Democrats have secured their best general election result in decades, winning at least 258 seats in an election sweep unseen since 1992 that creates not only vast opportunities to govern but also intense pressure to deliver on campaign promises and priorities.
Democrats have gained 44 House seats so far, four more than the 40 they picked up in President Donald Trump ’s first midterm in 2018.
The 258-seat tally was reached Sunday after Democrat Chuck Hubbard defeated Republican Rep. Virginia Foxx in North Carolina. Four other House races remain outstanding: one each in Minnesota and Tennessee and two in Louisiana that are heading to a December runoff.
The milestone in the 435-member House sets up divided government, with the Senate also in Democratic hands and with a Republican president in the White House . Emboldened Democrats are preparing a 100-day agenda to address high costs of living while also confronting Trump with a vast oversight agenda for the remainder of his second term in office.
The Democrats’ majority will be bigger than any the party has seen in elections since Bill Clinton was first elected president in 1992 (258) or the election of Barack Obama in 2008 (257), yet not quite the high-water mark of the Franklin D. Roosevelt-era, which saw House Democratic majorities swell past 300.
“Like, hell yeah, we should feel pressure,” said Democratic Rep. Jason Crow of Colorado, a former Army Ranger.
“There are people dying in this country and people losing their healthcare, losing their livelihoods, losing their farms, being terrorized from ICE," he said earlier this month at the Capitol, referring to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement. "If you don't feel a sense of urgency and pressure in this job, and a desperation to deliver for folks, then you don't belong under this Capitol dome."
The numbers underscore the extraordinary scale of Democratic wins, which spanned from the strongest Republican states to the Midwest and East Coast, as voters, angry over high prices and the Iran war and concerned over corruption, made clear their discontent with Trump.
Read more Peltola defeats Sullivan in Alaska Senate race, expanding Democratic majority
Taking control of both the House and the Senate come January, the Democrats will carry with them the backing of voters and the expectations to deliver. The Senate Democrats won a 56-seat majority in the 100-member chamber, their biggest advantage in over a decade.
The Democrats, as part of their 100-day agenda, are planning swift votes to reverse the Republicans’ Medicaid cuts and restore the Affordable Care Act tax credits the Republicans allowed to expire.
Democrats have vowed to marshal their subpoena powers and launch a flurry of investigations to exert the role of Congress as a check on presidential power. That includes plans to probe how Trump and his family have become wealthier since he returned to office. Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries of New York, who is in line to become House speaker, has not ruled out trying to impeach Trump for a third time.
“This is a historic moment for our country. This is one of the largest classes we have seen,” said progressive leader Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez , D-N.Y., at the Capitol.
Rep. Tom Suozzi, a centrist Democrat from New York and an accountant by profession, said the House Democrats should focus 75% of their time on affordability issues and 25% on accountability.
“Everything should be tied back to the people — and how it’s affecting the people,” he said.
For example, he said, as the Democrats launch investigations into Trump's financial dealings, they should be connecting the dots: “How does that affect people’s pocketbooks?”
The White House has issued a warning to Democrats over their planned probes into the administration, going as far as claiming that such investigations — a standard oversight function of Congress — may amount to “blatant criminality.”
After House Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., struggled to keep the House functioning for the past two years with a narrow single-digit majority — meaning a few GOP lawmakers could derail the agenda — the Democrats will have a wide margin that provides the new leadership much more room to maneuver.
Jeffries, who is poised to make history as the first Black speaker of the House if his colleagues elect him to the job on Jan. 3, 2027, will be able to lose dozens of Democrats on any given vote and still have the 218 needed for passage, in the face of GOP opposition.
"We're not a monolith — people come to the caucus with different ideas — it's OK,” said Rep. Troy Carter, D-La., who is expected to lead the Congressional Black Caucus.
Republicans saw their number of House seats fall to one of the lowest tallies in decades. They're far from the end of the Obama administration, when the House Republicans won 247 seats in the 2014 election and the rise of Newt Gingrich when they won 230 seats in 1994.
Rep. Jim Jordan of Ohio , who was elected by his colleagues to be the Republican leader in the minority, vowed to fight their way back to power.
“Over the next two years, House Republicans will fight for American families,” Jordan said.
The GOP's high-water marks include the 1920 election, with 301 seats for House Republicans.

Leny Yoro’s red card for Manchester United after just eight minutes paved the way for a 4-0 football defeat at Anfield.
Mauricio Pochettino endured a nightmare start to his Manchester United reign as the 10-man Red Devils were humbled 4-0 by old rivals Liverpool at Anfield Stadium.
Leny Yoro’s red card eight minutes in set the tone as Andoni Iraola’s side raced into a 2-0 lead after just 13 minutes and spurned a host of chances before adding to their advantage after the break.
United have now conceded 34 goals in all competitions – the most of any top-flight team in any of Europe’s major leagues. But in truth, the hosts could well have matched, or even surpassed, their famous 7-0 victory in 2023 in this fixture.
Pochettino’s side sit 19th, a point off the bottom of the table, in English football’s Premier League, with eight points from 11 games. Meanwhile, the Reds are up to fourth, seven points behind leaders Arsenal.
Liverpool were already well on top when the game turned after eight minutes as Matthijs de Ligt – who struggled throughout after being handed his first Premier League start in 357 days in Pochettino’s first selection – was caught out by a long ball down the left channel which allowed Alexander Isak to race towards goal.
Yoro chased him back and, despite a heavy touch from the Swede on the edge of the box, his clumsy challenge just outside the area led to a straight red card for denying a goal-scoring opportunity.
Matters got immediately worse for the visitors as Dominik Szoboszlai whipped home the low free kick, beating Bruno Fernandes on the end of the wall and the dive of Senne Lammens in goal to find the bottom corner.
It was 2-0 just three minutes later, when the lively Rio Ngumoha glided into the box on the left and fired a cross into the middle, which Florian Wirtz pirouetted to turn home with a close-range volley off the underside of the bar.
With United in disarray at the back, Pochettino brought on Harry Maguire in place of Bryan Mbeumo to form a five-man defence.
Although the visitors found a foothold in the game, the home pressure continued as Isak and Ngumoha fired narrowly past the post while Alexis Mac Allister was denied by a smart save from Lammens and Isak’s shot on the turn was somehow deflected over the top by the diving Maguire.
Szoboszlai saw a long-range effort tipped over by the flying Lammens shortly after the turnaround and saw another effort saved soon after.
Bradley Barcola spurned a glorious chance of a third just before the hour after beating the offside trap, but dragged a tame effort well wide with only Lammens to beat.
Isak missed another wonderful chance after de Ligt misjudged a bouncing ball to allow him another clear run on goal, but the Swede lashed wildly past the near post when one-on-one with Lammens.
Barcola fired over the bar after spinning away from de Ligt on 65 minutes, but the Frenchman nipped past Lisandro Martinez and burst in behind the defence before squaring neatly for Ngumoha to slam home the third a minute later.
Martinez denied Barcola a fourth with a last-ditch block at the far post while Lammens dived to turn around a powerful Isak strike and clawed a curling Szoboszlai shot around the upright with 15 minutes to go.
Virgil van Dijk headed inches wide from a Wirtz cross, but Victor Munoz swept a sublime fourth eight minutes from time after a lovely reverse pass into the box from Wirtz.
United had the chance of a consolation in stoppage time as sub Joshua Zirkzee broke away and found Fernandes. But the United skipper’s shot was turned wide by Allison.

Emergency workers rushed to the scene in Dymer, near Kyiv , where a Russian drone strike had destroyed a section of a five-storey residential building from the first to the fifth floor. Footage released by Ukraine’s State Emergency Service showed rescuers using an extended fire ladder and an aerial platform to help residents escape from the damaged structure, while other teams searched through piles of debris for possible survivors .
According to Ukrainian authorities, nine residents, including one child, had been evacuated . The State Emergency Service initially said that up to seven people could be trapped beneath the rubble. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy later said that 14 people were unaccounted for.
The attack was part of a wider wave of Russian drone strikes reported across Ukraine overnight. Ukraine’s Air Force said 186 attack drones were launched, of which 161 were shot down.
In Kharkiv , a strike drone hit the Kyivskyi district and started a fire. In Chernihi v, a Russian strike set a wood-processing plant ablaze, while in Zaporizhzhia three people, including two children, were injured in an evening attack.
The extent of the destruction in Dymer raised fears for residents who might still be beneath the collapsed sections of the building . Rescue workers remained focused on removing debris and reaching potentially trapped people , with no confirmed outcome for those still missing at the time of the initial reports. The latest strikes once again exposed the dangers faced by civilians in residential areas as Russian aerial attacks continue across Ukraine.

Trendyol Süper Lig'in 12. haftasında Kasımpaşa ile Corendon Alanyaspor, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan Stadyumu'nda karşılaştı.
27. dakikada ceza sahası içinde Baldurrson, savunmanın müdahalesiyle yerde kalınca hakem penaltı noktasını gösterdi.
29. dakikada penaltı vuruşu için topun başına gelen Benedyczak, meşin yuvarlağı ağlarla buluşturdu: 1-0
45+2. dakikada Yusuf Özdemir'in ortasında meşin yuvarlak Rak-Sakyi'nin koluna gelince hakem bir kez daha penaltı noktasını gösterdi.
45+4. dakikada penaltı vuruşu için topun başına gelen Hadergjonaj topu filelere gönderdi: 1-1
İlk yarıda başka pozisyon olmadı ve takımlar soyunma odasına 1-1 eşitlikle girdi.
64. dakikada Corendon Alanyaspor gole çok yaklaştı. Hagi'nin ara pasında ceza sahası için sol çaprazda topla buluşan Yusuf Özdemir'in uzak direğe şutunda, top direk dibinden auta gitti.
90. dakikada Hajradinovic'in ortasında savunmadan ileri çıkan Cristian Ilie'nin altıpasta kafa vuruşunda, meşin yuvarlak üst direğin dibinden auta çıktı.
90+2. dakikada Kasımpaşa öne geçti. Rakip yarı sahanın ortalarından sol taraftan kazanılan serbest vuruşta Hajradinovic'in ortasında altıpasta ön direkte Benedyczak'ın kafa vuruşunda, top üst direğe çarparak filelere gitti: 2-1
Maçta başka pozisyon olmadı ve Kasımpaşa sahadan 2-1 galip ayrıldı.
Corendon Alanyaspor'da yardımcı antrenör Tamer Sivrikaya, pozisyonları sonuçlandıramadıklarını ve mağlup olduklarını söyledi.
Recep Tayyip Erdoğan Stadı'nda oynanan karşılaşmanın ardından düzenlenen basın toplantısında konuşan Sivrikaya, "Ekip olarak yeni geldik. 1,5 yıldır birlikte aynı formasyonda oynayan takımda bazı değişiklikler yapmak istedik. Bu durumun zaman zaman artı olduğunu, zaman zaman da nasıl geliştirebileceğimizi gördük." diye konuştu.
Hafta içinde 8 oyuncularının milli takımlarda bulunduğunu hatırlatan Sivrikaya, şunları kaydetti:
"Onların geç dönüşü, birlikte olamayışımız oyuna yansıdı. Topa sahip olduğumuz anlarda özellikle oyun başlangıçlarında oyun kurmalarda bazı opsiyonlar vardı. Bunu zaman zaman yansıtabildik. Bazen 3-1-6 oyun kurulumu yaptık, bazen de 4-1'li. Pozisyonları sonuçlandırsak galibiyetle dönebilirdik. 1 puan da değerli olabilirdi, bazen bireysel hatalar olabiliyor. Maçın son dakikasında gol yememiz bizi üzdü. Oyunu geliştireceğimiz, bu oyunla daha iyi seviyelere gelebileceğimizi söyleyebilirim."
Kasımpaşa'da teknik direktör Alfred Schreuder, ilk maçında galibiyet yaşadığı için mutlu olduğunu söyledi.
Recep Tayyip Erdoğan Stadı'nda oynanan karşılaşmanın ardından düzenlenen basın toplantısında açıklamada bulunan Schreuder, "Buranın hocası olarak ilk maçıma çıktım. Kendi evimizde oynamak iyi bir hissiyattı. İlk yarıya iyi başladık, pozisyonlar yakaladık. Defansta iyi pozisyon aldık. İyi pozisyonlar yakaladık ama kalemizde beraberlik golünü gördük. Mental olarak bizi aşağıya çekti ama devre arasında konuştuk moral verdik, güzel bir konuşma geçti. İkinci yarıya ilk yarı gibi başlayamadık ama buna alışacağız. Yüksek yoğunlukla çalışmaya alışacağız. Son dakikalarda iyi bir gol bize 3 puanı kazandırdı, çok mutluyuz." diye konuştu.
Schreuder, Benedyczak'a ilişkin soruya ise "Böyle iyi bir santrforun olması takım için iyi bir durum. Çok iyi bir gol attı. Bu kalitede bir santrforun olması tüm takıma özgüven veriyor." şeklinde yanıt verdi.
"Daha fazla taraftar getirmek her zaman daha iyi durumdur." diyen Schreuder, sözlerini şöyle tamamladı:
"12 gündür buradayım, takımla olan ilişkim gayet hoş. İki taraf da memnun. Mentalitesi çok iyi bir takım. Herkes rolünün farkında. Genç ve tecrübeli oyuncuların karması bir takım. Topla her zaman daha iyi olabiliriz, gelişmek için her zaman daha fazla çalışacağız."

Report and free match highlights as Manchester United are routed by Liverpool at Anfield in Mauricio Pochettino's first game; Leny Yoro received early red card before Liverpool ran riot; defeat keeps Man Utd in relegation zone, one point off bottom
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Mauricio Pochettino endured a horror start to his Manchester United tenure as his 10-man side were thrashed 4-0 by Liverpool at Anfield following Leny Yoro's early sending off.
Yoro saw red in the eighth minute when he was adjudged to have made a last-man foul on Alexander Isak, with Dominik Szoboszlai slamming home the resulting free-kick.
The decision was contentious, with Isak having seemingly lost control of the ball when he was fouled, but the double blow left the visitors in disarray and Florian Wirtz added an acrobatic second only two minutes and 46 seconds after the opener.
Liverpool fans taunted Pochettino with chants of 'you're getting sacked in the morning' following the second goal.
The Argentine's decision to hand Matthijs de Ligt a first Premier League start in 357 days backfired spectacularly, with the 27-year-old misjudging a high ball in the lead-up to Yoro's red card before the hosts punished more shambolic defending after the break.
Rio Ngumoha added the third when he converted Bradley Barcola's low cross following a rapid counter-attack, becoming the youngest scorer in the history of the fixture, with substitute Victor Munoz netting the fourth from a through ball by the excellent Wirtz.
The four-goal loss showed Pochettino the size of the task ahead and keeps United in the Premier League relegation zone, only a point off the bottom. They have conceded more goals than any other side in Europe's major leagues in all competitions, with 34.
The scoreline could easily have been worse for them, with Barcola and Isak among those to miss chances as Liverpool racked up 28 shots, 10 of which came from Wirtz passes.
The defeat was the heaviest in a Manchester United manager's first game since Lal Hilditch was beaten by the same scoreline a century ago, in 1926. It is the first time in 40 years that United have been in the bottom two at this stage of a season.
For Pochettino's counterpart Andoni Iraola, the result represents his first statement win since taking charge. Liverpool move back into fourth place, only a point behind Manchester City in third and seven points behind leaders Arsenal.
Manchester United head coach Mauricio Pochettino to Sky Sports :
"So painful. So disappointed. It's not okay to start a game in the Premier League with this situation.
"The game changed completely after six minutes. Now we can explain everything but the damage is done, it's so painful.
"The players are so, so feeling the pain of the result. I told them to be calm: it was an unfair situation that happened.
"We need to accept that reality. We need to try to increase our focus, concentration and make better decisions on the field.
"We also need to be critical on ourselves but some situations happened in the game that we are not happy."
"I enjoyed it. I have to do a lot more but I think we wanted to celebrate in that moment. It's nice to enjoy it with the fans.
"The supporters deserved it. We've been very good away and not good enough at home. It's always a big game against Man Utd.
"They played with 10 for most of the game but we still did our job.
"We created enough to score more than four, we missed chances.
"We need to be more ruthless, but luckily today it was not needed."
Sky Sports pundit Gary Neville : "This is where we've got to, where we're starting to write off 4-0 defeats at Anfield as if it's just the norm and what should be accepted.
"But the fan standards haven't dropped. They expect a Manchester United team to be competitive every single week, and what they're seeing now - Manchester United have got the worst defence in the whole of Europe, and they're currently second from bottom in the Premier League.
Sky Sports pundit Roy Keane : "United were desperate. So bad.
"Gary Neville's okay with 4-0? Are you telling me they could have done better? Four-nil is not too bad with 10 men? Has anyone ever got a result with 10 men? It can be done!
"People who played for the club said 4-0 is not too bad? Wow. Fans are applauding. Applauding what?
"We're blaming the board, blaming ownership, blaming managers. When do the players take responsibility for some decision-making?
"Liverpool probably should have scored eight, probably eight or nine. It's unbelievable chances they had.
"And everyone's coming off the pitch saying four is not too bad? I feel like swearing."

The rise of Cockroach Janta Party and what it reveals about the future of politics and journalism in India.
A youth-led movement born as online satire has unsettled Indian politics. Named after a dismissive remark by the chief justice, the Cockroach Janta Party has mobilised some of the country’s biggest protests in years. They have been driven by anger over exam leaks, unemployment and a lack of political accountability.
The demonstrators have been met by heavy police crackdowns and clashed with mainstream media outlets they accuse of serving the government.
As young Indians turn to social media and independent outlets to tell their stories, this film examines the growing divide between India’s youth and mainstream media and what it could mean for the future of politics and journalism.

The social services minister, Tanya Plibersek , has conceded it is “frustrating” that nations at Cop didn’t get a deal over the line but defended Australia’s involvement leading the talks.
Speaking to Sunrise, before the panel with One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce devolved into a slanging match, Plibersek said it was crucial all countries were there and came to the table:
double quotation mark I’m sure Barnaby would agree, if we’re going to take action to reduce carbon emissions, Australia can’t be the only country doing it.
It’s frustrating that we didn’t get further. I’m sure Chris [ Bowen ] is, you know, the most frustrated person I can think of right now because he put in many hours.
Just like the atmosphere, the temperature rises – and the two start arguing with each other over policy and cost.
Joyce says One Nation wants to “get away from your [Labor] policy which is destroying our nation”, while Plibersek asks him to say what the cost will be under his policy that would see more fossil fuels burned.
Cabinet minister Murray Watt says it’s increasingly difficult to bridge the divide between nations on climate policy after a pretty frustrating and disappointing COP summit that didn’t reach a final agreement.
Speaking to RN Breakfast, the environment minister, says it wasn’t a failure, and points to the fact that the US didn’t even send an official delegation.
On the proposed deal not including the words “fossil fuels” Watt says there were a range of nations that weren’t prepared to sign up if they were included… but in omitting them found another group of countries that refused to agree anyway.
double quotation mark It’s obviously a very deeply disappointing outcome that the cover decision was not agreed to by all nations.
I think what this shows is a very challenging international environment at the moment to reach agreement on almost anything and particularly a situation like this where you’ve got fossil fuel producers on the one hand and other countries that are experiencing very serious impacts from climate change. That’s a very wide divide to be bridged and it’s very disappointing that that wasn’t possible.
Serial blunders have caused the foreign policy sway of Australia’s most important ally, the US, to plummet on the Lowy Institute’s Asia Power Index, AAP reports.
The US led China in six of the survey’s eight criteria but trailed on diplomatic influence and economic relationships, while Washington’s foreign policy score posted its sharpest decline in the index’s nine-year history.
Anthony Albanese earned praise for inking deals with Singapore, Malaysia and Brunei to avert a fuel supply crisis caused by the war but his government scored much lower on advancing Australia’s diplomatic interests in Asia.
The institute’s report also comes on the heels of the prime minister pinballing between Turkey, the Philippines and China for the Cop31, Asean and Apec summits.
Albanese signed up to joint military exercises with Quad partners the US, Japan and India, and on Friday was lauded by the Chinese president, Xi Jinping, for achieving a “full turnaround” in Sino-Australian relations.
Researcher Jack Sato, who helped compile the annual report, said the week’s developments underlined some of the power index’s more optimistic findings.
double quotation mark We’re seeing much greater defence engagement between Australia and Japan, Australia and the Philippines, and the Philippines and Japan.
Even though I think it doesn’t quite come across in its overall score, that US defence relationship in the region is stronger, which is helping Australia.
The Liberals say it’s quite extraordinary the government put its hand up to co-host the UN climate summit in Turkey and failed to secure an agreement between nations.
It’s despite the summit going overtime to continue negotiations, making it the longest COP ever.
The EU, UK and some allies rejected a deal on the future of the climate which didn’t even mention fossil fuels.
The deputy Liberal leader says voters should be concerned Australia couldn’t broker a deal. Jane Hume told News24:
double quotation mark It’s pretty extraordinary, isn’t it? We’ve spent $150m to get Chris Bowen to Cop, to host Cop. Then we found out it was actually a co-host deal. Now we’re walking away without a deal at all. This is quite extraordinary.
It hasn’t been, since 2009, when Kevin Rudd was in Copenhagen, that we had no agreement, but to have no deal at all, this is quite exceptional, and I think it should be something that Australia should be concerned about.
The Cop co-president, Australia’s climate change minister, Chris Bowen, defended his leadership.
“Australia left nothing on the field,” he said, but the red lines the presidencies had tried to negotiate were “unbridgeable”.

Labor is also going to cop some heat (get it!) after climate talks broke down at the UN Cop summit where the energy minister, Chris Bowen, was the chief negotiator.

Australia has helped shape the international order before, in non-proliferation and in online safety. With artificial intelligence, we intend to do it again.

Kiralık Aşk'ın Koriş'i olarak hafızalara kazınan Onur Büyüktopçu, son dönemde verdiği kilolarla dikkat çekiyordu. Daha önce 'spor ve diyet' diyerek anlattığı zayıflama sürecinin perde arkasını bu kez açık açık paylaştı. Üstelik iğne kullandığı hâlde bunu saklayan ünlülere de sessiz kalmadı.
Bold YouTube kanalında yayınlanan 'Bana Ne, Sana Ne?' programına konuk olan Onur Büyüktopçu, zayıflama sürecine dair dikkat çeken bir itirafta bulundu.
Ünlü oyuncu, yaklaşık 28 kilo verdiğini ve bunu zayıflama iğnesi sayesinde başardığını söyledi. Ancak ilk zamanlarda bu gerçeği dile getirmediğini de gizlemedi: 'İlk böyle zayıfladığım dönemde evet dedim yani efendim diyet falan filan demiştim.'
Hatırlanacağı üzere Büyüktopçu, Mart 2025'te Snob Magazin kameralarına konuşmuş, iki ayda 15 kilo verdiğini söyleyerek 'Spor ve diyet' demişti. O dönem mide ameliyatlarına karşı olduğunu da vurgulamıştı.
Peki Büyüktopçu neden fikrini değiştirdi? Oyuncu, başka isimlerin de benzer açıklamalar yaptığını gördükçe rahatsız olduğunu anlattı: 'Maşallah yani bir insan çıktı içimden. Ben onları gördükçe sinirlenmeye başladım. Ben dedim ki ya, ben haksızlık ettim kendime.'
'Spor ve beslenme, diyet ve yaşam tarzı' açıklamalarının kendisine komik geldiğini söyleyen Büyüktopçu, şu sözlerle tepki gösterdi: 'Yıllardır verememiş o kiloyu birden nasıl veriyorsun sen bir ayda, 2 ayda? Ne oldu, böcek mi soktu da veriyorsun o kadar kilo?'
Büyüktopçu isim vermedi ama iddialı bir cümle kurdu: 'Kimlerin kullandığını ve kimlerin kullanmadığını gerçekten biliyorum.'
Sözlerinin bir öneri gibi algılanmasını istemediğini birkaç kez vurgulayan oyuncu, süreci doktor kontrolünde yürüttüğünü anlattı. Önce tahlil yaptırdığını belirten Büyüktopçu, doktorunun kendisine 'Eğer tahlillerde değerlerin kötüyse, asla iğneyi yapmam ben sana' dediğini aktardı. Tahlil sonuçları uygun çıkınca tedaviye başladığını söyledi.
Büyüktopçu'nun anlattığı bir ayrıntı ise dikkat çekti. Oyuncunun anlattığına göre, bir arkadaşı iğne olduktan sonra eve gelip koltuğa uzanmış. Film izlerken eşinin seslenmesine yanıt vermemiş ve bilinci kapanmış. Büyüktopçu, olayın ambulans çağrılmasıyla sonuçlandığını söyledi.
Büyüktopçu sözlerini şöyle tamamladı: 'O yüzden lütfen doktor kontrolünde olun oluyorsanız. Bu bir tavsiye değil.'

COP31 President Murat Kurum, center, leaves a closing plenary session at the U.N. Climate Summit, Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026, in Antalya, Turkey. Nearly 200 countries failed to reach an agreement on whether they should move away from fossil fuels like coal and natural gas. Khalil Hamra/AP hide caption
ANTALYA, Turkey – International climate talks in Antalya, Turkey, broke down in overtime hours with a disagreement over how to address fossil fuels, the main cause of global warming.
On Sunday, delegates from nearly 200 countries failed to reach an overall agreement covering targets for electrification, finance to help developing countries adapt to the impacts of climate change, and how to respond to the fact that the planet will soon breach a key warming threshold.
The talks ran two days longer than expected, becoming the longest climate conference in the history of these summits. And it ended in a dramatic fashion, with delegates from the European Union rejecting any final outcome that did not explicitly call for a transition away from fossil fuels. Burning fossil fuels like oil, gas and coal makes up roughly 73% of global emissions .
Ireland's Minister for Climate, Energy and the Environment Darragh O'Brien, who spoke for the EU, soon left the room, along with EU Commissioner for Climate, Net Zero and Clean Growth Wopke Hoekstra.
Other countries also objected to the text, including Panama, Belize, and small island states such as Vanuatu and the Marshall Islands.
Hoekstra said that with the world heading for an overshoot of 1.5 degrees, the EU could not tolerate an agreement that does not mention fossil fuels. "That is not acceptable," Hoekstra told reporters after walking out of the talks. "We do that with a heavy heart with many other countries, but we simply cannot accept this."
This is the first U.N. climate summit where there's been formal acknowledgment that the world will surpass a key global warming threshold. Countries agreed in 2015 to try to limit climate change to 1.5 degrees Celsius (2.7 degrees Fahrenheit), but the planet has essentially reached that limit already.
Passing that threshold means more severe climate impacts , like more intense hurricanes and heat waves. The United Nations found that a best-case scenario of 1.7 or 1.8 degrees Celsius would require cutting emissions immediately, reducing them by 45% by 2035 . That, scientists say, would require dramatically cutting fossil fuel use.
Meanwhile, the transition away from fossil fuels is happening regardless of what the U.N. agreements say, says Chris Bowen, the Australian minister who ran the negotiations.
Negotiations at this year's U.N. Climate Summit were supposed to end Friday but there was no agreement on language about fossil fuels. Activists demonstrated by holding signs that read "shame" at COP31, Friday, Nov. 20, 2026, in Antalya, Turkey. Khalil Hamra/AP hide caption
"The transition away from fossil fuels in the real world is inevitable," Bowen told the press after the agreement failed. "It's happening at speed and it's irreversible."
The disagreements over mentioning fossil fuels in climate conferences have a long, fractured history.
The COP process works by consensus, so nearly 200 countries must agree to a final text at the end of the negotiations. Some fossil fuel producers like Norway and Mexico have recently wanted to include transitioning away from fossil fuels in the text. Other large oil-producing countries like Saudi Arabia and Russia have blocked adding fossil fuels to the final agreement.
At the climate talks in Dubai in 2023, countries agreed for the first time in 28 years of conferences to mention transitioning away from fossil fuels in the final agreement.
Deeply frustrated with this U.N. process, more than 50 countries have created their own separate conference dedicated to phasing out fossil fuels. In April, they held the "First International Conference for the Transition Away from Fossil Fuels" in Colombia. In 2027, Ireland and the Pacific Island nation of Tuvalu will co-host the second conference.
These side efforts are the best hope for climate action until something changes in the COP process, says Juan Carlos Navarro, environment minister of Panama.
"I am an optimist by nature," he tells NPR, "but I am not an idiot."
This year, the ongoing U.S.-Israeli war with Iran and the unprecedented closure of the Strait of Hormuz loomed over the negotiations.
Since the war began, countries across Asia and Africa have accelerated their transitions to solar energy, batteries and electric vehicles, and reduced their reliance on fossil fuels like oil and natural gas .
COP31 organizers promised that this would be the "electrification COP." Climate technologies like renewable energy, super-efficient heat pumps and electric vehicles are also called electrification technologies. Many of these technologies are being manufactured in China, the main exporter of climate solutions.
The conference's initial goal was to increase global electrification from its current level of around 23% to 35% by 2035. "So 35 by '35 is the mantra," Kingsmill Bond, an analyst at the energy think tank Ember, told NPR when COP31 began.
The 35 by 35 electrification pledge was signed on to by dozens of countries. However, that pledge did not ultimately pass, says Alden Meyer, a senior associate at the climate change think tank E3G. "Electrification was collateral damage when the whole decision cratered," he said.
The Trump administration did not send a delegation to COP31 for a second year in a row. President Trump announced he would withdraw the U.S. from the Paris Agreement on his first day back in office in 2025. Trump has called climate change a hoax, and his administration has rolled back regulations on climate pollution and funding for wind and solar power and electric vehicles.
An informal delegation of congressional Democrats did come to Turkey. They told delegates at COP31 that when Democrats control both chambers of Congress next year, climate change will return to the main agenda.
While the debate over fossil fuels stole the spotlight at this year's COP, a major focus of the negotiations has been on money. Countries debated new goals for funding to assist nations hardest hit by climate change.
Over the years at climate summits, lower-income countries have made the case that while they're responsible for only a small share of the emissions causing climate change, they're experiencing some of the worst disasters.
"We're not a nation that has the luxury of debating whether climate change is real for us," says Matthew Samuda, Jamaica's minister of water, environment and climate change. "The reality is, over the last five years, we have had a category 4 hurricane, a tropical storm and a category 5 hurricane. So climate change for us is indeed real and we are experiencing economic losses from a problem that we didn't create."
In 2024, nations agreed to eventually provide $1.3 trillion per year to developing nations, what's known as climate finance. Only about $136.7 billion was delivered in 2024 , according to a report from the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development. The majority of that goes to projects that reduce emissions, including renewable energy like solar and wind.
As climate disasters become costlier, lower-income countries have been pushing for more funding to adapt to climate impacts, such as protecting coastal communities from sea level rise and strengthening infrastructure against storms. The United Nations estimates that those nations' needs will reach $305 billion annually by 2035 .
The COP31 U.N. Climate Summit ended Sunday in Antalya, Turkey and tens of thousands of people attended what has become the longest summit in the history of these gatherings. Khalil Hamra/AP hide caption
During the talks in Turkey, developing nations pushed for more concrete commitments to deliver adaptation funding. But those elements to deliver on tripling adaptation funding by 2035…

62. dakikada ev sahibi ekip beraberliği yakaladı. Sağ kanattan topla hareketlenen Deniz Türüç'ün ortasında topa iyi yükselen Enis Destan'ın kafa vuruşunda, meşin yuvarlak ağlara gitti: 2-2
79. dakikada konuk ekip yeniden öne geçti. Sol kanattan topla hareketlenen Poku'nun pasında topla buluşan Trossard'ın ceza sahası dışından sert şutunda, meşin yuvarlak ağlarla buluştu: 2-3
85. dakikada defanstan dönen topu alan Mustafa Muhammed'in ceza sahası dışından sert şutunda, top kaleci Nübel'de kaldı.
90+3. dakikada Beşiktaş farkı yeniden 2'ye çıkardı. Murillo'nun sağ kanattan pasında ceza sahasında topla buluşan Cerny'nin yerden düzgün şutunda, meşin yuvarlak ağlara gitti: 2-4
Beşiktaş'ın kulüp başkanı Serdal Adalı, MEDAŞ Konya Büyükşehir Belediye Stadyumu'nda oynanan maçın ardından yaptığı açıklamada, deplasmanda galip gelmelerinin kendileri açısından iyi olduğunu söyledi.
Konyaspor yönetimi ve camiasına da teşekkür eden Adalı, "Bizi çok iyi ağırladılar. Konyasporlu futbolcular da iyi mücadele etti, onları kutluyorum." diye konuştu.
Adalı, hakemlerle ilgili bir şikayetinin olmadığını, ancak Merkez Hakem Kurulundaki (MHK) bazı kişilerin hakemleri rahat bırakması gerektiğini belirtti.
Hakemlerin yönlendirilmemesi gerektiğini vurgulayan Adalı, şunları kaydetti:
"Anthony Taylor'​​a da bazı şeyleri empoze etmeye çalışmasınlar. Bu sadece Beşiktaş'ı değil, tüm Türkiye'yi ilgilendiren bir konu. Ofsaytla ilgili söyleyecek bir şey yok. Hiç oralara girmek istemiyorum. Çıplak gözle kim seyrederse seyretsin 'ofsayt değil' diyor. Teknoloji var, ofsayt demiş. MHK ile ilgili söylediğim sözlerde, gayet iyi gitmeye çalışırken gördüklerim, duyduklarım, hissettiklerim işi bulandırmaya çalışıyorlar, yapmasınlar."
Galatasaray ile oynayacakları maça da değinen Adalı, "İnşallah güzel, centilmence bir maç olur, hak eden kazanır. Daha önce de söyledim, yabancı hakem talebimiz yok, hakemlerimize güveniyorum. Eğer genç hakemlerle ligi düzeltemezsek ülke olarak bize ayıp olur. Bugün VAR'da bir yabancı hakem vardı, tartışacak olsak onu tartışırız. Önemli olan niyetler iyi olsun." ifadelerini kullandı.
Adalı, kendileri için her maçın önemli olduğunu, Avrupa'da da galip gelip yerlerini garanti altına almak istediklerini aktardı.
Maçın ardından düzenlenen basın toplantısında konuşan Beşiktaş'ta teknik direktör Vincenzo Italiano, "Pozisyon veriyoruz ve gol yiyoruz. Tabii bu hoşumuza giden, iyi olan bir şey değil. Ama ön tarafta iyi işler çıkardığımızı, geliştiğimizi söyleyebilirim. Trossard tekrar artık gol atmaya başladı. Vlahovic zaten gol atıyor. Bugün Cerny de yedekten girip gol attı. Yani ön tarafta bir gelişim var. Ama tekrar arkada hala pozisyon vermeye devam ediyoruz. Bence bunun sebebi tamamen dikkat ve konsantrasyondan kaynaklı." diye konuştu.
Italiano, Konyaspor'un attığı iki gole ilişkin, "Özellikle ilk golün harika olduğunu söyleyebilirim. Ama bizim daha dikkatli ve konsantre olmamız gerekiyor. Bence problem bu. Aynı zamanda bardağın dolu tarafına bakmak istiyorum çünkü ön tarafta gayet iyi işler çıkarıyoruz." dedi.
Ocak ayındaki transfer dönemine hayli süre olduğunun altını çizen Italiano, şöyle konuştu:
“Yaklaştıkça neler olacağını düşünürüz. Ama bence Trossard'ın merkezde olduğunda daha enerjik olduğunu söyleyebilirim. Kendisi daha az yoruluyor. Çünkü defansif olarak o sorumlulukları daha az alıyor. Geçen maçta asist yaptı, bugün de gol attı, iyi işler çıkarıyor. Bir şey daha söylemek istiyorum. Bugünkü maçtan birazcık korktuğumu söyleyebilirim. Çok zor olacağını biliyordum. Çünkü milli aradan sonraki maçlar hep çok zor oluyor. Bugün böyle bir maçı kazanmak bence harika ve zor bir işti.”
Beşiktaş'a 4-2 mağlup olan TÜMOSAN Konyaspor'da teknik direktör İlhan Palut, maçın ardından düzenlenen basın toplantısında, karşılaşmanın genelinde oyun üstünlüğünün büyük oranda kendilerinde olduğunu ancak Beşiktaş'ın son vuruş ve bitiricilik becerisiyle galip geldiğini dile getirdi.
Takımının 75. dakikaya kadar dengeli ve etkili bir oyun sergilediğini ve en az bir puanı hak ettiklerini anlatan Palut, şöyle konuştu:
“Futbolda 'golleri çıkarırsak' diye bir şey yok ama bu maçın olması gereken skoru, sahadaki mücadeleye göre bu değildi. Takım, en azından 1 puanı hak etmişti. Bunu sadece 2-0'dan 2-2'ye verdiğimiz reaksiyon olarak da söylemiyorum. 75'e kadar olan bölümle alakalı. Gol ve beceri önemli. Beşiktaş bugün o noktada bizden daha başarılıydı. Belki bizden daha başarılı oldukları tek parametre son vuruş ve bitiricilikti. Bunu da kabul etmek lazım. Oyuncularımın emeğine üzüldüm, çok çabaladılar. Bazı oyuncular yorulmalarına rağmen maçı taşımaya çalıştı. Beşiktaş'ı tebrik ediyorum.”

Mauricio Pochettino’s first game in charge of Manchester United turned into an Anfield nightmare as his side were beaten 4-0 by Liverpool. Adam Bate was there to see it unravel as Pochettino was confronted with the reality of the mess that is United...
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Well, they ran. They had to because there were only 10 of them for all but the first seven minutes. If running were the only problem then this mess might soon be solvable. But Manchester United's 4-0 defeat to Liverpool at Anfield highlighted more flaws than that.
Dismal defending, confused combinations, conceding in clusters, confidence long departed. And that all evident in the first quarter of an hour of what was never a contest. This is the only team in the Premier League without a win since August for a reason.
Welcome to Manchester United, Mauricio Pochettino. The new boss might be only days into a contract that runs until 2029, but it has not taken him long to see the mess he has inherited. Liverpool had this match won in 13 minutes. Unlucky for Pochettino.
And yet, even at this early stage of his reign, the Argentine cannot escape blame entirely. The decision to give Matthijs de Ligt his first Premier League start in almost a year was exposed as an error immediately. He was partially culpable for Leny Yoro's red card.
De Ligt's inability to judge the flight of the ball and then appear to give up the chase entirely was not the sort of support his young centre-back needed. Whatever the verdict on the decisions of Yoro and the referee, the Dutchman was given the runaround.
Man Utd head coach Mauricio Pochettino speaking to Sky Sports: “The ball was for the goalkeeper. In that situation, if you review the VAR you can see for sure, he never had the intention to connect with Isak. When the control was long with the striker, the ball was going to the goalkeeper, he runs and goes down. “In Leny's case, it wasn't intentional. It was an unusual situation that is normal, everyone who plays football can feel it. “I have to defend my club. And tell what I feel. That was an action that everyone who plays football, it was clear that it was a situation that was not a red card.”
His only previous start in any competition this season came in Como, where United were dismantled, and it all looked too quick for him. One wonders what Pochettino saw in training. Thrusting him into a game of this intensity was a massive mistake, regardless.
Maybe the subsequent substitutions will raise a few eyebrows too. The only way back into the game was on the counter-attack but the removal of Bryan Mbeumo and Matheus Cunha robbed United of any pace on the breakaway. That was a strange call too.
Kobbie Mainoo and Youri Tielemans paired together in midfield? That one might already have been discredited. And somehow the struggling De Ligt, desperately short of match fitness, was asked to labour on for the full 90 minutes of what was a chastening defeat.
The change of role for Diogo Dalot was a smarter switch - and an easy win for the coach - given how the Portuguese player had been caught out repeatedly in that left-back position under Michael Carrick. But the truth is that there were no real positives here.
The bar was so low as well. The seven previous away days had yielded no wins but a number of horrible moments. From the humiliation at Hull to the late equaliser conceded at Everton. From the crushing in Como to Carrick's final away defeat to Chelsea.
The dice have been rolled with this appointment, fragile hopes raised. When the fans in the Kop were mockingly chanting 'Poch is at the wheel' with 15 minutes still to go, and the fourth Liverpool goal yet to go in, it was a clue that the day had unravelled spectacularly.
Pochettino is not getting 'sacked in the morning' as the Kop repeatedly suggested, but the nature of this defeat means that his immediate challenge is to rebuild shattered confidence. What Ralf Rangnick once famously called open-heart surgery must wait.
How do you press high with defenders who do not feel comfortable following? How do you keep a compact midfield in the gap that this creates when mobility is a major weakness? Issues for another day. Ones that will take work and windows to fix, not mere weeks.
And yet, Pochettino will have to think short term as well as long. The Premier League table demands that on the day Hull City went six points clear of them. United are only one from safety, but can there be any confidence of them easing away from danger?
Since the start of the 2021-22 season, Liverpool's four wins by four goals or more against Manchester United are the most any Premier League team has achieved against another across all competitions. Accounting for three points for a win, Manchester United’s eight points this season are their fewest after 11 games of a league campaign since the 1972-73 season. That is also the previous season in which the Red Devils only managed one win through their first 11 league matches. Mauricio Pochettino suffered the joint-heaviest defeat by a Manchester United manager in his first game, along with a defeat by the same scoreline for Lal Hilditch in October 1926. This was the quickest Liverpool had gone 2-0 up in a Premier League match against Manchester United, going two ahead after just 12 minutes and 40 seconds. Manchester United boss Mauricio Pochettino was the first manager in Premier League history to see his team concede twice and receive a red card in the first half of his first match in charge of a club. Manchester United will end the day in 19th position in the Premier League, with this the first time since November 1986 that they have been within the bottom two places of the league table having played at least 10 matches. Leny Yoro’s eighth-minute red card was the earliest shown to a Manchester United player in a Premier League match.

Televizyon ekranlarının sevilen isimlerinden Onur Büyüktopçu, son dönemdeki fiziksel değişimiyle yeniden gündeme geldi. Özellikle Kiralık Aşk dizisinde canlandırdığı Koriş karakteriyle hafızalara kazınan oyuncu, konuk olduğu programda kilo verme sürecine ilişkin daha önce paylaşmadığı detayları anlattı.
Toplam 28 kilo verdiğini belirten Büyüktopçu, bu değişimin arkasında zayıflama iğnesinin bulunduğunu açıkladı. Daha önce kilo kaybını spor ve diyetle ilişkilendirdiğini kabul eden oyuncu, ilk dönemlerde kullandığı yöntemi kamuoyuyla paylaşmadığını söyledi.
Büyüktopçu, Mart 2025'te verdiği bir röportajda iki ayda 15 kilo verdiğini açıklamış ve zayıflama sürecini spor ile beslenme düzenine bağlamıştı. O dönem mide ameliyatlarına sıcak bakmadığını da dile getiren oyuncu, son açıklamasıyla kilo verme sürecinin perde arkasını aydınlattı.
Zayıflama iğnesi kullandığını açıklamasının nedenlerinden birinin diğer ünlülerin tutumu olduğunu belirten Büyüktopçu, benzer yöntemlere başvurduğunu düşündüğü kişilerin yalnızca diyet ve spor yaptıklarını söylemesini eleştirdi.
Bu durumun kendisini rahatsız ettiğini ifade eden oyuncu, geçmişte gerçeği açıklamadığı için kendisine de haksızlık ettiğini düşündüğünü belirtti. Bazı kişilerin uzun süredir veremedikleri kiloları kısa sürede kaybetmesini sorgulayan Büyüktopçu, kullanılan yöntemlerin açıkça paylaşılması gerektiğini savundu.
Herhangi bir ismi hedef göstermeyen oyuncu, zayıflama iğnesi kullanan bazı ünlülerin kimler olduğunu bildiğini ileri sürdü. Büyüktopçu, bu konuda yaptığı açıklamada, "Kimlerin kullandığını ve kimlerin kullanmadığını gerçekten biliyorum" ifadelerini kullandı.
Kilo verme sürecinde dürüst davranılmasının önemli olduğunu vurgulayan oyuncu, "Bence gerçek söylenmeli" diyerek düşüncesini dile getirdi.
Zayıflama iğnelerinin olası risklerine de değinen Büyüktopçu, bir arkadaşının yaşadığı sağlık sorununu anlattı. Oyuncunun aktarımına göre iğne kullanan arkadaşı, evine döndükten sonra koltuğa uzanarak film izlemeye başladı. Bir süre sonra eşinin seslenmelerine yanıt vermeyen kişinin bilincini kaybettiği fark edildi. Bunun üzerine sağlık ekiplerine haber verildi.
Yaşanan olayın kendisini endişelendirdiğini belirten Büyüktopçu, zayıflama iğnelerinin bilinçsizce kullanılmaması gerektiğine dikkat çekti. Oyuncunun açıklamaları, son dönemde gündemde olan hızlı kilo verme yöntemleri ve bu yöntemlerin sağlık açısından taşıyabileceği riskleri yeniden tartışmaya açtı.

Kastamonu'nun Taşköprü ilçesine bağlı Ortaöz köyünde 22 yıldır sigara içilmiyor. Köy muhtarı Mahmut Sezer'in öncülüğünde 22 yıl önce başlatılan uygulama, Ortaöz köyü ve bağlı 3 mahalledeki vatandaşın ortak mücadelesiyle yıllardır sürdürülüyor. 40 haneli köyün girişinde de ziyaretçileri, "Sigara içilmeyen Ortaöz köyüne hoş geldiniz" tabelası karşılıyor. Köydeki açık ve kapalı alanlarda sigara içilmesine izin vermeyen köy sakinleri, herkese örnek oluyor.
Köy muhtarı Sezer, 22 yıl önce bu uygulamayı başlattıklarında herkesin karşı çıktığını ama daha sonra tüm vatandaşların sigarayı bıraktığını söyledi.
Köyde 22 yıldır sigara içmenin yasak olduğunu belirten Ortaöz köyü muhtarı Mahmut Sezer, "22 yıl önce çok büyük mücadelelerle sigarayla ilgili başlattığımız durumu başarıyla gerçekleştirdik. Tüm komşuların, arkadaşların yardımıyla bunun üstesinden geldik. Köy sınırları içerisinde sadece kapalı alanlarda değil, açık alanlarda da sigara içirtmiyoruz. Köye gelenler de bundan memnunlar. Sigara içenler bile tabelaları gördüğü zaman ya da biz söyleyince sigaralarını ceplerine koyuyor. Herkes zaten duydu, saygı gösteriyorlar" dedi.
İlk zamanlarda uygulamaya bazı vatandaşların tepki gösterdiğini anlatan Sezer, "Çok tepki aldık. Hatta öyle kaçak şekilde içenler oldu ki gelip o levhaların altında kümelenip sigaraları yaktılar. Hemen bunları da haber yaptık. Biz de şikayet ettik. Jandarma bile ilgilendi. Zaman içerisinde bunlar da unutuldu. Her geçen yıl devam ediyoruz. Herhangi bir sıkıntımız yok. Herkes artık buranın sigara içilmeyen köy olduğunu öğrendi ve alıştı" diye konuştu.
Kendisinin de 30 yıl sigara kullandığını belirten Sezer, "Ben 30 yıl sigara içtim. Çalıştığım iş yerinde genel müdür gelir kontrol ederdi. 'Gene mi sigara içiyorsun' diyecek diye aklım çıkardı. Onun için oradayken bırakmıştım. Buraya gelince de aynı mücadeleyi sürdürdük. Yazları çok genç geliyor. Gençlerle çok mücadele veriyoruz" şeklinde konuştu.
Çevre mahallelerde yaşayan vatandaşların da sigarayı bırakabilmek için kendilerinden destek istediklerini anlatan Sezer, "Birlikte bıraktık. Burada KOAH hastaları vardı, makineye bağlı olanlar vardı. Hava almak için makineye bağlanıyor ama çıkar çıkmaz hemen sigarayı yakıyor. Onları da örnek gösterdik. Bu kadar temiz havanın içerisinde sigara içilmesi herkese zarar veriyordu. Çok şükür bundan da kurtuldular. Ben devam ettiğim müddetçe bu uygulama böyle devam edecek. Kimse bizim gözümüzün önünde açıkta sigara içemez. Hangi mahalleme gidersen git, her taraf tertemiz" ifadelerini kullandı.
Köy sakinlerinden Selfinaz Doğan da 49 yıllık eşi Murat Doğan'ın kendisi için sigarayı bıraktığını anlatarak, "Doktor, eşimin sigara içmemesi gerektiğini söyledi. Kanımda nikotin olduğunu öğrenince eşim de bırakmaya karar verdi. 2004 yılında 14 Şubat Sevgililer Günü'nde benim için sigarayı bıraktı. Evimiz tertemiz. Hiç duman, is olmuyor. Allah herkese böyle sigara içilmeyen bir ortam nasip etsin" dedi.
Murat Doğan ise eşi sayesinde sigarayı bıraktığını ve bu durumdan dolayı çok mutlu olduğunu söyledi. Sigarayı bıraktıktan sonra kendisini daha iyi hissetmeye başladığını söyleyen Doğan, herkese sağlıklı bir yaşam için sigarayı bırakmalarını tavsiye etti

Boca Juniors'un kaptanı Leandro Paredes, Copa Sudamericana finalinde Atlético Mineiro'yu yenip kupayı kazandıkları gecenin ardından canlı yayında bayıldı. Kolombiya'nın Barranquilla kentindeki Metropolitano Stadı'nda DSports'a röportaj veren Paredes, sözlerini tamamlar tamamlamaz yere yığıldı. Önlem amacıyla bir kliniğe kaldırılan futbolcu, kısa süre sonra sosyal medyadan iyi olduğunu duyurdu. Boca'nın Arjantin'e dönüş uçuşu da ertelendi.
Final düdüğünün ardından ailesi de sahaya gelen ve tribünler tarafından ayakta alkışlanan Paredes, son derece duygusal ve yorgun görünüyordu. Maçın ardından 'Tam bir mutluluk , bir hayalimi gerçekleştirdim' dedi.
DSports'a konuşurken 'Yaşadıklarımı anlatmaya kelimeler yetmiyor. Mutluyum ve minnettarım. Şimdi keyfini çıkarma ve şükretme zamanı' diye konuştu. Ardından bir yana bakıp bilincini kaybetti ve yere düştü.
Sağlık ekipleri Paredes'e hemen müdahale etti ve futbolcu kısa sürede kendine geldi. Yayında durumunun stabil olduğu açıklandı, Boca da kaptanının toparlandığını duyurdu.
Paredes ikinci yarının 13. dakikasında oyundan çıkmış ve yerini Tomás Belmonte'ye bırakmıştı. La Nación, değişikliğin Barranquilla'daki yüksek sıcaklık ve susuz kalmanın yol açtığı tahmin edilen tansiyon düşüklüğünden kaynaklandığını yazdı.
Boca'nın teknik direktörü Rodolfo Arruabarrena, maç sonrası basın toplantısında Paredes'i soyunma odasında gördüğünü anlattı. Arruabarrena 'Bir düşüş yaşadı, başı dönüyordu' dedi. Belirtilerin ilk yarının sonuna doğru başladığını, Paredes'in devre arasında biraz toparlandığını ama ikinci yarıda kenarlara koşmakta zorlandığını söyledi. Paredes'in çok dürüst davranıp değişiklik istediğini de ekledi.
